best_idea: Answer which authored town is nearest a point, within a radius, with one squared-distance scan over the anchors, ties to the lowest id, and no answer outside the radius, instead of a blocky tile grid.
decision_why: Frankendom zones are already data on one runtime, so one anchor per town with a radius gives the respawn town after a death and the area label without a tile grid; reject the 2^15-unit square grid as the main lookup because the donor's own doc says its boundaries are not zone polygons, and keep the grid only for a zone authored as tiles.
acceptance: A player who dies in the open field respawns at the nearest town anchor within 10000 units of the death point, and the area label names that town; a server test asserts that a point with no anchor in range returns no anchor, so the zone's default town is used.
